decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1) The proposed development would result in an intrusive element in the open aspect of the site from what is unacceptable infill development and loss of open space in an area that falls within an area of publicly accessible open space deficiency. This is contrary to Policies ENV.N.1.11 (Protection and Improvement of Local Open Space), H.6.3 (Backland/ Infill Development) ENV.1.13 (Allotments) of the Adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan. 

Condition : 2 - 2) The proposal will have an adverse affect upon the character and appearance of the site and surrounding area and the proposal would result in the loss of a visual break. This is contrary to ENV.N.1.11 (Protection and Improvement of Local Open Space) of the Adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Outline application for residential development with associated parking.
